verdict.rationale: Termius syncs data through end-to-end encrypted cloud vaults, so data-residency choice is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows any option to pick a storage region or residency location. Claims that infrastructure is 'stored and encrypted locally' describe an adjacent behavior, not a user-selectable region.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
